site.name: Open Creative Suite
site.description: PixelDotNet and VectorDotNet: professional image editing and vector design tools. Free forever, source-available, with no subscriptions and no accounts.

products.name: PixelDotNet
products.tagline: An editor that gets out of the way.
products.blurb: A desktop image editor for the jobs people actually do: retouching a photo, cutting out a subject, building a poster, or painting something from scratch.

hero.alt: PixelDotNet editing the Moonlight sample artwork, with the tool rail, canvas and layer stack visible

shots.label: Painting
shots.caption: Brushes, shapes, gradients and editable paths, all on their own layers.

shots.label: Cut-outs
shots.caption: Quick Selection and layer masks for clean subject cut-outs without the fuss.

shots.label: Text effects
shots.caption: Live outlines, shadows and neon-style glows that stay editable.

features.title: Paint and draw
features.body: A round brush with size, hardness and opacity, plus eraser, lines, rectangles, ellipses, gradients, paths and live text.

features.title: Retouch the mess
features.body: Clone Stamp, Healing Brush, Dodge and Burn, Content-Aware Fill, perspective and mesh warp: the everyday repair kit.

features.title: Cut it out clean
features.body: Quick Selection, Magic Wand and layer masks. Lift a subject off its background and keep the edges honest.

features.title: Layers that behave
features.body: Masks, clipping, groups, blend modes and smart objects. Non-destructive shadows, strokes and glows.

features.title: Type with teeth
features.body: Editable text layers with outlines, shadows and glows, plus text on a path when the layout asks for it.

features.title: Real files, no lock-in
features.body: PNG, JPEG, BMP, TGA, SVG and layered .pxd projects. Batch-resize and convert a folder when the brief changes.

shots.label: Workspace
shots.caption: The full canvas: tools on the left, layers on the right, and a sample you can start painting on immediately.

shots.label: Selections
shots.caption: Lift a subject out of its background, refine the mask, and keep the original pixels.

shots.label: Text
shots.caption: Set type with live effects, then reopen it tomorrow and change the words.

products.name: VectorDotNet
products.blurb: A desktop vector studio for illustration, icons, logos and layout. Draw real Bézier paths, shape them, style them and export clean SVG.

hero.alt: VectorDotNet showing a poster artboard, live rounded rectangle selection and the inspector

shots.label: Canvas
shots.caption: Artboards, rulers, live shapes and a stable workspace that keeps up with the pointer.

shots.label: Colour
shots.caption: An HSV field, alpha strip, recent colours and a palette pulled from your document.

shots.label: Typography
shots.caption: Every installed family, previewed in its own face, plus your own font files at runtime.

features.title: Draw real curves
features.body: A pen with cubic anchors and mirrored handles, a smoothing pencil, lasso and full direct-selection editing.

features.title: Live shapes
features.body: Rectangles, ellipses, stars, polygons and spirals keep their parameters. Change a corner radius or add points later.

features.title: Snap to anything
features.body: Smart guides for object edges and centres, artboards, the grid and dragged ruler guides, with Shift to constrain.

features.title: Documents, organised
features.body: Nested groups, unlimited layers, locks, visibility, artboards, tabs and independent undo histories.

features.title: Colour and type
features.body: An HSV picker with alpha and document palettes; searchable system fonts with live previews and runtime font loading.

features.title: Clean SVG in and out
features.body: Import SVG and SVGZ into editable groups and paths. Export standards-compliant SVG or SVGZ, not a flattened picture.

shots.label: Workspace
shots.caption: The sample poster: artboards, a live selection, and every object still editable in the layer tree.

shots.label: Colour
shots.caption: Pick a colour with the field and strips, or pull one straight from the artwork.

shots.label: Typography
shots.caption: Search every installed family, preview it in its own face, or load a font file on the spot.
